Your music, from your own server.
own.audio keeps your music for you. Upload it once and play it here.
Sample music on a shared own.audio server, no account needed.
Your sign-in stays on this device, encrypted. Subsonic servers get a one-time token made from the password; Jellyfin gives a token and the password isn\'t kept.

Works with own.audio, Navidrome and Jellyfin; the app finds out which. Without http:// or https://, it tries https and then http. Your sign-in stays on this device, encrypted.\n\nown.audio: sign in with your account\'s email and password.
The library shows the selected server. Music from any server can stay in the queue.
own.audio Music is free and open source (MPL-2.0). It talks only to the servers you add.

What you add to the library is yours. Share songs from their menu, or a whole album or playlist; everyone in the family can then play them. Smart playlists can be shared too: each member gets their own selection.
